lines.text: Many learners say: She has three sister.

native.hook: 超过一个，名词要加 s！
native.tip: 中文“三个姐妹”名词不变，英语里超过一个，名词后面要加 s。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “She has three sister.”？😅 中文说“三个姐妹”，名词不用变；英语里数量超过一个，名词要加 s：“She has three sisters.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“She has three sisters.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In English, a noun needs s when there is more than one.
en.caption: Do you say “She has three sister.”? 😅 In English, a noun needs s after a number: “She has three sisters.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
